scope: Shared ProjectWorkspace Save As/revision URL binding, live-editor preservation and stale refresh fencing. Runtime/editor/client bytes are unchanged.
problem: A durable Save As reply reached the native editor before asynchronous project refresh adopted its new asset/revision in the URL. Immediate reload reopened the original file.
behavior: Committed non-copy results update the exact reload URL before project metadata refresh. A later revision adopts its actual host binding even while earlier Save As metadata is pending. Older refreshes and callbacks from an unmounted editor cannot retarget the current document; Copy preserves the binding and the existing iframe.

validation.regression: Actual ProjectWorkspace and EmbeddedEditor with a transport peer and real request identities: held refresh, Save As URL before acknowledgement, Copy, later save, older refresh release, same iframe and exact full reload. Baseline reproduced the production failure; patched source passes. Genuine SubCraft/native acceptance is recorded separately.
